project.name: 33-nop-treesitter
project.description:
Pure-Java runtime for the Tree-sitter parsing ecosystem. Replaces the C runtime with a Java implementation so that Nop applications can use 200+ Tree-sitter grammars without JNI / FFM native dependencies. Inspired by gotreesitter (Go).
Module layout (initial — may split into api/core/loader submodules as size grows): - io.nop.treesitter public API: TSLanguage, TSParser, TSTree, TSNode, TSQuery, TSQueryCursor, TSTreeCursor - io.nop.treesitter.lexer lexer state machine + keyword recognition - io.nop.treesitter.parser LR/GLR parser + graph-structured stack - io.nop.treesitter.subtree Subtree arena (compact int32 index, slot reuse) - io.nop.treesitter.query S-expression query compiler + executor - io.nop.treesitter.scanner external scanner bytecode VM - io.nop.treesitter.language parse-table binary blob loader - io.nop.treesitter.cursor tree cursor - io.nop.treesitter.util interning, UTF-8 utilities
